hypothesis: Family-selective contextual uptake should mediate observable operation or answer changes and yield nonnegative answer utility relative to shuffled and cold controls.

strata.contextual_only: contextual primary uptake true and shuffled primary uptake false
strata.both_adopt: contextual and shuffled primary uptake both true
strata.neither_adopt: contextual and shuffled primary uptake both false
strata.shuffled_only: contextual primary uptake false and shuffled primary uptake true
